content:
Sophia Chen: quick heads-up — Brightlane's renewal is ready but e-sign is blocked. procurement wants Net 60; pricing team ok with 2% off for 2yrs. link to contract: https://rbw.co/brightlane-contract-v3 :eyes:
Ethan Morales: @Sophia can you confirm which clause procurement changed? they mentioned payment terms and 'termination notice' window.
Matt Reynolds (Procurement): we asked for Net 60 and `Section 5` update: invoice due 60 days after receipt. also need PO before signing.
Laura Patel (Legal): saw redline. also added data residency text in `Section 9.2` — customer wants EU-only processing. that's the blocker for our standard e-sign flow.
Kevin Ortiz (Finance): PO is fine, finance just needs billing contact and VAT info. once PO is in, we can accept Net 60 but need invoice schedule clarified.
Sophia Chen: Brightlane said they'll provide PO by EOD Friday. Legal flagged that EU-only processing needs to be approved by infra — looping in infra offline. For now e-sign waits on legal sign-off. :hourglass:
Docusign Bot: Envelope 0x9c45... status: 'needs_action' — signer Laura Patel (Legal) required. Last updated 1772021340.
Ethan Morales: can we get a temporary workaround? sign master with a rider? that might speed it if infra review delayed.
Laura Patel (Legal): prefer rider with explicit data residency appendix. drafting now — I'll attach draft once ready.
Matt Reynolds (Procurement): if they send PO and rider, procurement can sign same day. please confirm billing contact.
Kevin Ortiz (Finance): billing contact: accounts-payable@brightlane.com (from previous SOW). Confirm VAT: BR-12345.
Sophia Chen: thanks. action items: 1) Laura to post rider draft (ETA 2pm PST) 2) Brightlane to send PO (ETA EOD Fri) 3) Ethan to confirm billing details to procurement. I'll follow up in the morning and post Docusign envelope id when Laura signs. :white_check_mark:
Ethan Morales: noted. pinging @Brightlane CSM on the thread.
Laura Patel (Legal): rider draft uploaded: https://rbw.co/drafts/brightlane-rider-2026 — pls review, especially Section 2 (data residency) and Section 7 (billing cadence).
Sophia Chen: great — keeping this open. will close thread once signed. thanks everyone.
